Kärnan i modellen: samma block 32 gånger: The core of the model: the same block 32 times. We walk through every tensor created along the way.
<b>Pre-norm</b>: strömmen får växa fritt: Pre-norm: the stream can grow freely, but every block reads a normalized copy of size 1. That is why a final norm is needed before the LM head.
<b>Post-norm</b> (originalet 2017): strö: Post-norm (the 2017 original): the stream itself is normalized after every addition.
<b>Pre-norm</b> (Llama och de flesta mod: Pre-norm (Llama and most modern models): the block normalizes a copy before it reads. The stream itself is left untouched and can grow.
När man hela tiden lägger till antecknin: When you keep adding notes, the numbers grow larger and larger. Normalization scales them down to an even level before the next step reads them.
<b>Problemet.</b> Eftersom varje block <: The problem. Because every block adds to the stream, x grows in size the deeper you go into the model. Attention and the MLP, however, work best when their input always has roughly the same scale.
<b>Lösningen</b> är normalisering: skala: The solution is normalization: rescale a vector so that its size (RMS) becomes 1, without changing the direction. The formula comes on the RMSNorm slide.
<b>Var</b> man normaliserar finns det tv: There are two variants of where to normalize:
Pre-norm gör djupa modeller stabilare at: Pre-norm makes deep models more stable to train, because the path straight through the stream is never disturbed. The price is that the stream is never normalized along the way, so it must be normalized once at the end, before the LM head. That is the final RMSNorm.
Kurvan är en illustration. Att strömmens: The curve is an illustration. The stream's size does grow with depth in pre-norm models, broadly speaking, but exact values vary between models.
Storleken på strömmen och på det blocken: The size of the stream and of what the blocks read, through 32 blocks

Här är den exakta formeln för normaliser: Here is the exact formula for the normalization: divide every number by the vector's average size.
Normaliseringen skalar varje tokens vekt: The normalization scales each token's vector so that its RMS becomes 1, then multiplies by a learned weight per dimension:
Utan normalisering skulle storleken på s: Without normalization the stream would grow in size layer by layer, since everything is added. Attention and the MLP want their input at a stable scale.
RMSNorm är en förenklad LayerNorm: ingen: RMSNorm is a simplified LayerNorm: no mean subtraction and no bias. Cheaper, and works just as well.
Riktningen bevaras, storleken normaliser: The direction is preserved, the size is normalized. That is why directions in the stream are meaningful.

Varje ord har ett anteckningsblock som f: Every word has a notepad that travels with it through the whole model. Every floor reads it and adds a note, but never erases.
Varje token har en vektor med 4096 tal s: Every token has a vector of 4096 numbers that travels through the whole model. It is called the residual stream, and we write it x.
Tänk på den som ett anteckningsblock per: Think of it as one notepad per token. Every block in the model reads the notepad, works out a short note and adds it. Nothing erases what is already written there.
Namnet kommer från <i>residual connectio: The name comes from the residual connection: each block only produces a correction, a remainder, that is added on top. The path straight through, where x passes unchanged, always remains.
Det ger tre fördelar: information från t: That gives three benefits: information from early blocks survives to the end, deep models train stably, and the stream becomes the natural place to measure and steer the model, as Astra did.
8 dimensioner i stället för 4096. Kontur: 8 dimensions instead of 4096. The outline shows the most recent contribution.
Åtta dimensioner av residual stream som: Eight dimensions of the residual stream changing as contributions are added
En decoder-only transformer är ett block: A decoder-only transformer is one block (attention + MLP) repeated L = 32 times, where each token only sees the tokens before it. The task: fill every token's vector with context.
Residual stream x är en arbetsyta per to: The residual stream x is a workspace per token that every block reads and adds to. Its shape [T, 4096] never changes until the LM head.
Pre-norm: blocken läser en normaliserad: Pre-norm: the blocks read a normalized copy, the stream itself can grow and is normalized only once, before the LM head.
Ett lager är hela blocket: 7 viktmatrise: A layer is the whole block: 7 weight matrices (Wq, Wk, Wv, Wo, W_gate, W_up, W_down) and 2 norm weights, about 218 M parameters. All 32 layers have the same shapes but different values.
Varje lager är två rader: x = x + Attent: Every layer is two lines: x = x + Attention(RMSNorm(x)) and x = x + MLP(RMSNorm(x)). The normalization is done on a copy; the stream itself is only added to.
Attention flyttar information mellan tok: Attention moves information between tokens (along T). The MLP processes each token separately (along d) and works as thousands of detectors.
Attention är det enda stället där positi: Attention is the only place where positions exchange information: Q [32, T, 128], K and V [8, T, 128], scores [32, T, T].
Causal mask: position i ser bara 0..i. D: Causal mask: position i only sees 0..i. That is why K and V never change for old positions.
RoPE roterar Q och K så att bara avstånd: RoPE rotates Q and K so that only the distance between positions matters.
MLP:n arbetar per position: [T, 4096] →: The MLP works per position: [T, 4096] → [T, 14336] → [T, 4096], and accounts for 70% of the parameters.
Totalt 8,03 B parametrar, ungefär 16 GB: 8.03 B parameters in total, about 16 GB in bf16.

<b>Strömmen kan läsas var som helst.</b>: The stream can be read anywhere. After any block it is the same kind of vector, which interpretation methods exploit.

en <b>encoder</b> som läser hela källtex: an encoder that reads the whole source text, where every word sees all the others
en <b>decoder</b> som skriver översättni: a decoder that writes the translation one word at a time and only sees what has already been written
”Transformer” är namnet på byggritningen: “Transformer” is the name of the blueprint that all modern language models follow. “Decoder-only” means the model reads the text from left to right and continues it.
<b>Transformer</b> är en arkitektur som: Transformer is an architecture presented in 2017 in the paper “Attention Is All You Need”. The new idea was to let attention, the mechanism where tokens fetch information from each other, do almost all the work. Everything in this course is a transformer.
Originalet byggdes för översättning och: The original was built for translation and had two halves:
<b>Decoder-only</b> betyder att man bara: Decoder-only means keeping only the second half. That is enough to continue text: the prompt and the response are a single sequence, and every token only sees the tokens before it. The GPT and Llama families are built that way.

Ett ord vet till en början inget om orde: At first a word knows nothing about the words around it. The model's job is to let the words share information, until the last position knows enough to guess the next word.
Efter modul 2 har vi en vektor per token: After module 2 we have one vector per token, x [T, 4096]. But each vector only knows something about its own token. The vector for “på” does not know that it was a cat that sat.
För att gissa nästa token behöver sista: To guess the next token, the last position needs to know everything relevant about the whole text: who does what, where, and what usually comes next.
Det är jobbet för resten av modellen: <b: That is the job of the rest of the model: fill every token's vector with context, step by step, until the last one is enough to predict what follows.
Det som gör jobbet kallas en <b>transfor: The thing that does the job is called a transformer. The next slides explain the word, then how it is built.
Etiketterna beskriver i ord vad vektorer: The labels describe in words what the vectors roughly carry. In the model it is just numbers, and the content is not that neatly separated.
